instruction.text: This is a map showing the continents of the world. Select the image that shows Europe.

atoms.b: Europe is made up of over 40 ((++countries continents)), with a population of around 740 million people.
Europe is bordered by the Atlantic Ocean in the west and the Arctic Ocean to the ((++north south)).
Russia is the ((++largest smallest)) country in Europe and is found in the very east of the continent. It is part of both Europe and Asia.
The ((++smallest largest)) country in Europe, and also the world, is the Vatican City. This independent city-state is situated in the heart of Rome in Italy.

hint.label: Arctic Circle
hint.text: The Arctic Circle is an imaginary line circling the northernmost region of the Earth.

atoms.text: Europe is the second-smallest continent and is located in the Northern Hemisphere. Most of its countries experience a temperate climate, with warm summers and cool winters.
Some regions in Northern Europe are located within the Arctic Circle, such as parts of Norway and Sweden. They experience a polar climate, where summers are short and winters are long and cold.
In Southern Europe, countries have a warmer Mediterranean climate. These countries, such as Spain, experience dry, hot summers and mild winters.

atoms.b: The European Union (EU) is a political and economic ((++union onion)) between 27 of the countries in Europe. All EU countries have ((++open closed)) borders and EU citizens can travel and work freely between them.
atoms.sound: The European Union, or EU, is a political and economic union between 27 of the countries in Europe. All EU countries have open borders and EU citizens can travel and work freely between them.

atoms.b: EU countries also trade freely with one another, which is ((++good bad)) for businesses. Most of the countries within the EU also share the euro as their official ((++currency language)).
The European Parliament regularly votes on new ((++laws languages)) for EU countries. It is located across three different European cities: Strasbourg, Brussels and Luxembourg City.
